{{Quote|Your evil is at an end, Sith.|Jun-Fan, as he tries to kill Darth Maul|<ref name="TSH" />}}
'''Bruu Jun-Fan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Jun-Fan was selected to participate in a [[Unidentified task force (Plo Koon)|task force]] with the objective of tracking down the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]&mdash;who was believed to have been [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|slain]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] [[32 BBY/Legends|twelve years earlier]]&mdash;and his brother, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Jun-Fan and the task force traced the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] brothers to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Norwe]] and [[Skirmish on Orto Norwe|confronted]] them, though Maul and Opress managed to escape. During the skirmish, both Jun-Fan's Padawan, [[Tatsu]], and Kenobi were injured, causing Jun-Fan and the remaining Jedi to pursue the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Jun-Fan, [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and Jedi Master [[Ko Solok]] [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|confronted]] Maul and Opress on the world [[Pleem's Nexus]], with Jun-Fan [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combating]] Maul himself. He was injured by one of Maul's [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic legs]], and [[Death/Legends|succumbed]] to the injuries dealt to him by the Zabrak after the brothers escaped.

==Biography==
{{Quote|&hellip;I believe ''Master Bruu Jun-Fan's'' expertise would be most suitable for the mission.|Plo Koon, discussed adding Jun-Fan to the task force|<ref name="TSH" />}}
Brun Jun-Fan, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He obtained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at a young age, and was noted for his skills in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]&mdash;which was aided by his connection to the Force&mdash;and his abilities with [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometry]], a [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] that allowed him to pick up information and impressions from an object and discern the events that the object was directly or indirectly involved in. Jun-Fan also took the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Tatsu]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="TSH" />

[[File:Jun-Fan_fighting_droids.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jun-Fan combats battle droids.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jun-Fan fought against forces of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="TSH" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]&mdash;who was thought to have been [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|slain]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]<ref name="TSH" /> [[32 BBY/Legends|twelve years earlier]]<ref name="EGTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="TSH" />&mdash;resurfaced during the war with the aid of his brother and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Jun-Fan was selected by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to take part in a [[Unidentified task force (Plo Koon)|task force]] whose objective was to hunt down and capture [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul and Opress. Jun-Fan, along with Tatsu, accompanied Masters Koon, Kenobi, [[Ko Solok]], [[Grohto]], and a team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Orto Norwe]], which was the last known location of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] brothers. The task force found a [[Unidentified cantina (Yellowblade's Landing)|cantina]] where members of the criminal gang [[The Scourge|Scourge]] lay [[Death/Legends|dead]] on the floor. Jun-Fan used his psychometric abilities to devine that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were responsible for the [[Massacre in Yellowblade's Landing|massacre]] and noted that the Zabraks were in a nearby [[Cave/Legends|cave]].<ref name="TSH" />

When they tracked Maul and Opress to the [[Unidentified Scourge base|Scourge gang's base]] in the caves, Jun-Fan and the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] began to [[Skirmish on Orto Norwe|combat]] several [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] that Maul released. The other Jedi, meanwhile, attempted to capture Maul and Opress, who ultimately managed to escape with a [[Esano's sister|hostage]] after killing Grohto and [[Cho mai/Legends|maiming]] Tatsu. Jun-Fan used his psychometric abilities on a piece of jewelry that the Sith's hostage had dropped, gathering that they were headed to the planet [[Pleem's Nexus]]. Jun-Fan, Koon, and Solok left Tatsu and Kenobi behind due to their injuries and followed Maul and Opress to Pleem's Nexus. They confronted the brothers at a [[Unidentified castle (Pleem's Nexus)|castle]] as the Sith were attempting to load some treasure&mdash;which they planned to use to establish a criminal empire&mdash;on their [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="TSH" />

[[File:Jun-Fan_chokes_Maul.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jun-Fan chokes Darth Maul.]]
During the ensuing [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|duel]], Jun-Fan and Solok tried to convince Maul to reveal his [[Palpatine/Legends|former Master's]] identity. Maul used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] his [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at Jun-Fan, who dodged the attack, although the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Shiak|impaled]] Solok and killed him. Jun-Fan proceeded to use his unarmed abilities to try and overpower Maul, and eventually began to choke the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], determined to end what he considered Maul's evil actions. However, Maul repositioned his right [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic leg]] and kicked Jun-Fan in the abdomen, mortally wounding the Jedi Master. After Maul and Opress escaped when Kenobi and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighters]], Jun-Fan died in Koon's [[Limb/Legends|arms]].<ref name="TSH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I feel the Force around me&hellip; taking me&hellip; This is one mystery I will explore first, Master.|Jun-Fan, to Plo Koon, as he succumbs to the injuries dealt to him by Darth Maul|<ref name="TSH" />}}
Bruu Jun-Fan was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and kept himself in good physical condition. He was interested in what happened to an individual upon their demise, believing it to be a mystery. Jun-Fan was dedicated to capturing Darth Maul and Savage Opress, and during his confrontation with Maul on Pleem's Nexus, he attempted to try and convince Maul to reveal his former [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master's]] identity. However, after Maul's lightsaber killed Ko Solok, Jun-Fan abandoned that mentality and was determined to end Maul's life. After Maul mortally wounded Jun-Fan, he remarked that he felt the Force taking him while he was dying.<ref name="TSH" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Where experience he lacks, compensates with skill he does&hellip; unparalleled in the galaxy Master Jun-Fan's Force-combat abilities are.|Yoda, on Jun-Fan's abilities|<ref name="TSH" />}}
Jun-Fan was noted for achieving the rank of Master at a young age, and his skills in Force-combat were regarded by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] as being without equal. Jun-Fan was able to defeat [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], and he also defeated wampas with blows to their throats and heads. He had good reflexes, being able to dodge Maul's lightsaber when the Sith Lord threw it at him, and was able to overpower Maul in a physical grapple. In addition to his martial arts prowess, Jun-Fan was also skilled in psychometry.<ref name="TSH" />

==Equipment==
When practicing combat, he was bare-chested and wore brown slacks, and used a lightsaber with a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="TSH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bruu Jun-Fan appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]'', written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and released on [[August 28]], [[2012]]. He was drawn by [[Vicenç Villagrasa]].<ref name="TSH" />
